claims.claim_ar: إنَّ حرف نصب وتوكيد، واسمها في هذه التراكيب هو ضمير (نحن) منصوب — أي اسم إنَّ منصوب وعلامة نصبه فتحة مقدَّرة.
claims.claim_en: The particle 'إِنَّ' is a particle of emphasis that causes the following noun (the ism of إنَّ) to be in the accusative (mansub). In contexts like this verse the ism corresponds to the pronoun 'نَحْنُ' and is understood as منصوب (with an implied/fixed vowel marking).
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited chunk only shows an instance with ‹إِنَّا› in a verse; the chunk does not contain an explicit grammatical exposition of the rule, so the claim is a standard grammatical inference from the example and should be checked against the full commentary text.

claims.claim_ar: إِلَيْنَا جار ومجرور قائم مقام ظرف (ظرف جهة/جابِه) متعلق بالفعل/الخبر (هنا: متعلق بلفظ يرجعون/راجعون) — أي بيان جهة الرجوع ('إلينا').
claims.claim_en: The prepositional phrase 'إِلَىٰ-na' (to Us) functions as a circumstantial prepositional phrase (a zarf/ʼila construction) and is attached (related) to the verb/clause (in the verse: 'they return to Us'). It indicates the direction/goal of returning.
